reviews.x: I had one of the first Epilady back in the 1980's and really liked it.  In fact, I bought a second one when the first 'gave out' after 5 or 6 years of continuous use.  Really like the smooth result when using it - no scratchy stubble on legs.  Even as hair grows back it remains soft and barely noticeable (and I have had dark hair).   When I needed a third Epilady the original style was no longer available.  I bought and used the 'new' style but did not find it as satisfactory -- took longer to o

reviews.t: Reason to switch from tweezer to coil
reviews.x: Had the old coil one 25 yrs ago and lost it after a few moves, went to purchase a new one and they had changed the design to a bunch of tweezers pulling hairs. Total crappola, I couldn't figure out why my hair kept growing back so quickly, saw the newer coil design bought it and love it. Let me tell you why, the tweezer pulls hair out whereas the coil rips the hair out thereby weakening the hair follicle. Less and less hair grows over the next few months, pretty soon you're epiladying every few

I own the original Epilady!  I bought it years ago and am in my 60's now.  I've always been careful to clean it well, brushing the coils with an old toothbrush and alcohol, and letting it run a bit, and cleaning again.  The thing that is nice about the Epilady at my age is that you're not scraping skin off, as with a razor, so your skin doesn't get as dry.

I have been using the Epilady Trio since I purchased it in 1988.  That's 25 years!  There were periods in there that I did not use it, but used it more often than not.  My first one finally stopped working - after 25 years!  Definitely going to purchase another.  Great product!
I bought this for my mom after her old one broke and she absolutely loves it. It's exactly like the old school one they don't sell in stores anymore.

reviews.t: Great Addition to My Hair Removal Tool Arsenal
reviews.x: This is a great product for those who want to invest in a less messy alternative to waxing. While it does take some going over of the same areas, leaving some temporary redness and discomfort, overall I am quite satisfied with the Epilady Trio Coil. It has substantially decreased the time I spend on hair removal. I did notice it doesn't work well on areas where the hair has strong roots. Those I still wax. Words of warning to those who aren't wax fans - the Epilady is painful just like waxing.

Doesn't work on my fine hair and doesn't work on my thick hair. Disappointed since it was rather expensive. Wouldn't recommend. A refund was offered, but I have already given it away. They do stand behind their product.

I stole mine form my mom about 5 or 6 years ago and I love it. It no longer hurts after all this time so that's cool. Now I need a new one because my daughter tried it and liked it and stole it form me cause she is VERY hairy and needed to shave every day.

reviews.t: exactly what i ordered and expected.
reviews.x: Had one in the 80's.  Lost it do to a house fire.  My sister still has her's and refused to give it up.  Works better than the newer models.

Excellent product, delivered immediately, I love you guys. So efficient. I highly recommend this product. I bought my first one around 30 years ago. Thanks to that I barely have any hair in legs or arm pits. The old machine is still working, but the cable tore after so many years. Finally I found it, cost 100 bucks but it's worth it. How much do you actually pay for getting rid of the unwanted hair. This is the simplest and most efficient way, believe me.

I bought the original (which this is) 28 years ago, and it just broke!  So glad to see that Epilady still makes it!  I love it!  Use it on my arms (only occasionally), almost all my arm hair is gone.  Same price I paid 28 years ago!  Great seller!

...and it is still going strong! I love this little machine! What a God-send for quickly getting rid of unwanted hair. I use it on my feet, toes, belly. It's truly a great product. It is a pit painful, but well worth the result of removing annoying and ugly hair at the root and being hair free for weeks. It eventually killed the hair roots in the areas I had done for years, now those areas have much less to almost no hair growth. I wished it weren't so expensive. Frankly, it is overpriced compar

reviews.t: The original is still the best.
reviews.x: I was very excited to see the original Epilday come back on the market. I had one years ago and loved it. I have not been disappointed by this one. Works just as well as I remember.
Are you kidding me?  This was the most painful experience of my life!!!  and my co-worker J hated it too!!!! If you like torture, this is the product for you!
Love this product, when I saw that they brought the older version back I immediately retired my newer version of my Epilady and replaced it with this.

When shopping for an alternative to a razor and wax I remember my mother owned an Epilady.  So when I saw her same one up for sale I thought id try it.  The results are inconsistent at best.  Id say it removed 40% of my leg hair from the root, another 40% was just ripped at the surface of my skin leaving stubble, and the last 20% despite being a a 1/4" long couldn't be grabbed by the device.  It was like rolling over that piece of paper on the floor with the vacuum a million times every whi

reviews.t: Happy girl.  My favourite Epilady is resurrected.
reviews.x: This is a replacement for an Epilady Coil epilator that was dying after 25 years.  It worked so well that even as it was going through it's death throes I refused to bury it until a proper replacement came along.  Epilady must have been listening because they reissued this.  Instead of working with a multiple tweezer head, this works with a coil that spins.  It catches the hair and pulls it out quickly.  No it's not painless, but with time it is less so and the winner is that with time the hair

reviews.t: It lasts for almost 4 weeks before I have new hair growth re-appearing.
reviews.x: My mother -in-law bought me my first epilady in 1996. I used it until it died on me several years later. I saw it being advertised on an American Airlines product magazine while flying one day. Checked with Amazon and found their price comparable to the supplier but of course I got free shipping with Amazon so I purchased it from them. I do not use razors. I only use Epilady Tri Coil Epilator on my legs, arms, bikini area, and underarms. It lasts for almost 4 weeks before I have new hair growth

I owned an epilady years ago. Why I quit using it, I don't know. Where it went, I don't know. It's what I remember and is much quicker to shower when you don't have to shave legs or arm pits! The 'stinging' you feel the first few times of use is worth it! I haven't seen any ingrown hairs, yet. Maybe because I'm exfoliating.

Love the original, old-school epilady. this epilady works everywhere there is hair (except for nose and ear hair, i suppose, unless you're extremely creative!).  You don't need the very small one for face, underarms or bikini area as they would like you to think. this one does it all, just be careful with it.

reviews.t: It worked fine, but for the last 3 months the cord ...
reviews.x: I bought this about a year ago directly from the epilady website.  It worked fine, but for the last 3 months the cord will not stay plugged in to the device.  It just randomly falls off every 30 seconds while you are trying to use it.  This makes it basically useless.

I'm very disappointed with this.  I had a Epilady 20 years ago and this is not as effective as the old one I had.  I had to do multiple passes over the same areas and it still didn't get all the hairs.  It was a huge waste of money for me.

I have been using Epilady for many years with excellent results.  The new model does offer 3 speeds which I haven't used the lower speeds to date. The max speed is is best for my leg hair removal and is working as expected.
My mom swears by these. I knew right away amazon would have them. This one came fast and works great. She is thrilled and will use it for another twenty years. Very happy customer.

claims.text: Many reviewers are long-time owners who used the original Epilady for decades and are glad the classic design is back.
Reviewers praise the smooth, long-lasting hair removal results, with some noting reduced hair growth over time.
Several reviewers note the device can be painful or cause temporary redness and discomfort.
A few reviewers report the product did not work on their hair type or was disappointing for the price.
Some reviewers mention the older/original model works better than newer designs.
